## [purpose] Purpose

Prepare a short handoff for the midwife containing the concern, sources and uncertainty, requested action and a secure delivery method.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

90 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 8 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Confirm the locally approved channel and form. Write the four handoff elements on paper for the observer.

## [opening] Opening

A barangay meeting asks about missed visits. What should be shared?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

The first response fits planning. Forms and names expose unnecessary personal details; an opinion is not evidence of the cause. Individual follow-up goes to the appropriate health team member.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Shares a personal form publicly or omits a clear requested action. A handoff gives the right person enough to act while protecting private details.

## [practice] Practice activity

Replace “The family is difficult” with three sentences: Liza’s concern; confirmed and unconfirmed details; help requested from the midwife. Add the authorized channel and how receipt will be confirmed. Ask a partner whether the next step is clear. Alone, check the four elements. In the next handoff, confirm the recipient and follow-up owner.

## [answer-key] Answer key

1. The aggregated childcare barrier and a question about scheduling.

The first response fits planning. Forms and names expose unnecessary personal details; an opinion is not evidence of the cause. Individual follow-up goes to the appropriate health team member.

## [observe] Observe

Includes concern, source, uncertainty and requested action; selects the right recipient and channel; specifies how follow-up will be confirmed.

Ready: Includes concern, source, uncertainty and requested action; selects the right recipient and channel; specifies how follow-up will be confirmed. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Gives an accurate report but no follow-up owner; ask who should respond and how receipt will be confirmed.

Not yet: Shares a personal form publicly or omits a clear requested action.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Gives an accurate report but no follow-up owner; ask who should respond and how receipt will be confirmed. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.

## [sources-review] Sources and review notes

Draft for review. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 28; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 18, 19, 30. Teach-back is an instructional addition supported by AHRQ. Verify local referral contacts before delivery. Outstanding visual, audio, source and pilot checks are in the separate review report. No new certification rule.

## [purpose] Layunin

Gumawa ng maikling ulat para sa midwife na may concern, pinagmulan at hindi pa tiyak na detalye, hinihinging aksyon at ligtas na paraan ng pagpapadala.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

90 minuto para sa pinadali na pagsasanay. Bahagi ito ng 8 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Tiyakin ang lokal na aprubadong channel at form. Isulat ang apat na bahagi ng ulat sa papel para sa observer.

## [opening] Pambungad

Humihingi ang barangay meeting ng paliwanag sa missed visits. Ano ang ibabahagi?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Ang unang sagot ay angkop sa pagpaplano. Ang forms at pangalan ay naglalantad ng hindi kailangang personal na detalye; ang opinyon ay hindi ebidensya ng dahilan. Ang indibidwal na follow-up ay sa tamang health team member.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Ibinabahagi sa pampublikong grupo ang personal na form o walang malinaw na hinihinging aksyon. Ang ulat ay sapat para makakilos ang tamang tao, habang protektado ang pribadong detalye.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Palitan ang “Mahirap kausap ang pamilya” ng tatlong pangungusap: concern ni Liza; natiyak at hindi pa tiyak; tulong na hinihingi sa midwife. Idagdag ang awtorisadong channel at paano kukumpirmahin ang pagtanggap. Ipabasa sa kapareha: alam ba niya ang susunod na hakbang? Kung mag-isa, suriin gamit ang apat na bahagi. Sa susunod na ulat, kumpirmahin ang tumanggap at may-ari ng follow-up.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

1. Ang pinagsamang childcare barrier at tanong tungkol sa iskedyul.

Ang unang sagot ay angkop sa pagpaplano. Ang forms at pangalan ay naglalantad ng hindi kailangang personal na detalye; ang opinyon ay hindi ebidensya ng dahilan. Ang indibidwal na follow-up ay sa tamang health team member.

## [observe] Obserbahan

May concern, pinagmulan, hindi pa tiyak at hinihinging aksyon ang ulat; pinipili ang tamang tatanggap at channel; tinutukoy kung paano kukumpirmahin ang follow-up.

Kaya na: May concern, pinagmulan, hindi pa tiyak at hinihinging aksyon ang ulat; pinipili ang tamang tatanggap at channel; tinutukoy kung paano kukumpirmahin ang follow-up. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Tumpak ang ulat ngunit walang follow-up owner; ipatukoy kung sino ang sasagot at paano malalaman kung natanggap.

Hindi pa: Ibinabahagi sa pampublikong grupo ang personal na form o walang malinaw na hinihinging aksyon.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Tumpak ang ulat ngunit walang follow-up owner; ipatukoy kung sino ang sasagot at paano malalaman kung natanggap. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [sources-review] Sanggunian at tala sa pagsusuri

Draft para sa pagsusuri. DOH Facilitator Guide: PDF 28; BHW Reference Manual: PDF 18, 19, 30. Ang teach-back ay dagdag na paraan ng pagtuturo mula sa AHRQ. Suriin ang mga lokal na referral contact bago gamitin. Nasa hiwalay na review report ang natitirang visual, audio, source at pilot checks. Walang bagong tuntunin sa sertipikasyon.

## [handoff] Report enough for action

BHW Gibs has heard Liza, 29, describe a childcare barrier to attending the health center. The last attendance date remains unconfirmed.

Gibs uses the approved form: date, relevant concern, information source, action taken and needed follow-up. For example: “Liza reports difficulty finding childcare; last attendance date needs verification. Requests a conversation with the midwife about scheduling.” Send this to the appropriate health team member through an authorized channel. Keep names and private details out of public group chats. Confirm receipt and identify who will act next.

## [audience] Adapt the message to the audience

Liza and the midwife need different information. Liza needs a plain next step and a contact. The midwife needs the concern, verified details and requested help. A barangay planning meeting needs aggregated barriers without identifying people. Choose a picture, spoken explanation or secure written report to fit the audience and purpose; do not turn a private case into a public story.

## [meeting] Present at a meeting without names

In this exercise, three fictional households share a childcare barrier. Prepare a one-minute report without names or identifying details: what is the pattern, what information is missing, and what small service change could be discussed? End with a clear question for the group. Do not promise that a proposal is approved before the responsible people decide.

## [practice] Try it, then repeat

Replace “The family is difficult” with three sentences: Liza’s concern; confirmed and unconfirmed details; help requested from the midwife. Add the authorized channel and how receipt will be confirmed. Ask a partner whether the next step is clear. Alone, check the four elements. In the next handoff, confirm the recipient and follow-up owner.

## [check] Choose the next step

Choose an answer and explain why before viewing the feedback. Then compare it with your own practice attempt.

## [handoff] Iulat ang kailangan para makakilos

Si BHW Gibs ay nakinig kay Liza, 29. Sinabi ni Liza na walang magbabantay sa anak kaya mahirap pumunta sa health center; hindi pa nakumpirma ang huling attendance.

Ginagamit ni Gibs ang aprubadong form: petsa, kaugnay na concern, pinagmulan ng impormasyon, ginawa at kailangang follow-up. Halimbawa: “Ayon kay Liza, problema ang magbabantay sa anak; petsa ng huling pagpunta ay ibeberipika. Humihingi ng pakikipag-usap sa midwife tungkol sa iskedyul.” Ibigay ito sa tamang health team member sa awtorisadong paraan. Huwag ilagay ang pangalan at pribadong detalye sa pampublikong group chat. Tanungin kung natanggap ang ulat at kung sino ang susunod na kikilos.

## [audience] Iangkop ang mensahe sa tatanggap

Magkaiba ang kailangan ni Liza at ng midwife. Kay Liza: payak na susunod na hakbang at kung sino ang lalapitan. Sa midwife: maikling concern, natiyak na detalye at hinihinging tulong. Sa barangay planning meeting: pinagsama-samang hadlang na walang pagkakakilanlan. Pumili ng larawan, pasalitang paliwanag o ligtas na nakasulat na ulat ayon sa layunin at kakayahan ng tatanggap; huwag gawing pampublikong kuwento ang pribadong kaso.

## [meeting] Ipaliwanag sa pulong nang walang pangalan

Sa pagsasanay, tatlong kathang-isip na pamilya ang may parehong hadlang sa childcare. Maghanda ng isang minutong ulat na walang pangalan o detalyeng makakakilala sa kanila: ano ang pattern, anong impormasyon ang kulang, at anong maliit na pagbabago sa serbisyo ang maaaring pag-usapan? Tapusin sa malinaw na tanong sa grupo. Huwag ipangakong aprubado na ang mungkahi bago magpasya ang may tungkulin.

## [practice] Subukan, saka ulitin

Palitan ang “Mahirap kausap ang pamilya” ng tatlong pangungusap: concern ni Liza; natiyak at hindi pa tiyak; tulong na hinihingi sa midwife. Idagdag ang awtorisadong channel at paano kukumpirmahin ang pagtanggap. Ipabasa sa kapareha: alam ba niya ang susunod na hakbang? Kung mag-isa, suriin gamit ang apat na bahagi. Sa susunod na ulat, kumpirmahin ang tumanggap at may-ari ng follow-up.

## [check] Piliin ang susunod na hakbang

Piliin ang sagot at ipaliwanag kung bakit bago tingnan ang feedback. Pagkatapos, ihambing sa sarili mong ginawa sa pagsasanay.
